turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome in. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hello, doctor. Well, what brings me in is... I've been having this trouble with my eating. Once I start eating those comfort foods, I tell myself, "Maria, that is enough." But my hand just goes right back to the pot. It's like I just can’t make myself stop once I get started.

symptom_reasoning.S050: The patient clearly describes a subjective inability to control or stop eating once they start, stating they cannot make themselves stop even when telling themselves it is enough.

turns.doctor_question: After one of these episodes where you feel you can't stop eating, do you do anything afterward to try to get rid of the food or make up for it—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?
turns.patient_response: No, no, I don't do any of that. I don't make myself throw up or take any pills or anything like that. And I'm certainly not out exercising a whole lot at my age. turns.doctor_question: How often would you say these episodes of feeling out of control with eating happen—for example, how many times per week, and how long has this been going on?

turns.doctor_question: During these episodes, do you tend to eat alone or hide how much you're eating because you feel embarrassed about the amount?

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any other changes recently, like unexplained weight gain, feeling unusually tired or sluggish, or feeling cold more often than before?
turns.patient_response: No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. My weight has stayed about the same, I think. And I don't feel any more tired or cold than usual for someone my age. It's really just the eating that's been bothering me.

turns.doctor_question: During these episodes, would you say you're eating an unusually large amount of food—more than most people would eat in that same amount of time—or is it more that you feel out of control even with a normal-sized portion?

turns.doctor_question: During these episodes, do you notice yourself eating much faster than usual, and do you feel intense guilt, disgust, or depressed afterward because of how much you ate?
